crossContact.statement: Official page says Houlihan's is not a gluten-free environment and asks guests with nut or other food allergies to inform staff. Linked DoorDash warns food is prepared in common areas and may contact other food products.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: We offer gluten-sensitive menu items but are not a gluten-free environment; guests with allergies should inform staff.
Chefs prep and cook to order in common areas, and menu items may come in contact with other food products.
